SCIENTISTS STILL CAN’T IDENTIFY THIS ANIMAL 
Scientists went nearly 9,100 meters beneath the Pacific Ocean…

And their cameras recorded something they still cannot confidently identify.

The strange animal slowly glided toward the seafloor in the Izu-Ogasawara Trench.

It resembles parts of familiar deep-sea animals—but experts could not assign it to a definite group from the footage.

At these depths, even identifying what you’re looking at can become a scientific mystery.
